description: Main window permissions. Deliberately reduced to the strict minimum (CLAUDE.md §8): no shell, no filesystem read or write, no network plugin. no dialog permission either: the file picker is opened from Rust by `contacts_pick_file`, so the WebView never names a file — it only receives one the operator chose, and the backend refuses to import anything else. Every later addition must be justified in review — a capability granted 'for later' is attack surface acquired for nothing in return.
